3.Sub-event_summary: Preparation and execution of the Panzer Lehr counterattack on the night of 10–11 July 1944, planned by Generalleutnant Fritz Bayerlein with two regimental combat teams converging on St. Jean-de-Daye crossroads, delayed jump-off just before dawn on 11 July due to American pressure at Hauts-Vents.
